title: 2007 AMC 12B Problem 6
statement: Triangle \(ABC\) has side lengths \(AB=5,\) \(BC=6,\) and \(AC=7.\) Two bugs start simultaneously from \(A\) and crawl along the sides of the triangle in opposite directions at the same speed. They meet at point \(D.\) What is \(BD?\)

solutions.text:
The perimeter is \(5+6+7=18,\) so each bug crawls \(9\) before they meet.

The bug going \(A\to B\to C\) reaches \(D\) on side \(BC,\) having traveled \(AB+BD=9.\) Since \(AB=5,\) we get \(BD=4.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Together the two bugs cover the whole perimeter, so each crawls half of it
One bug travels \(A\to B\to D,\) a distance of \(AB+BD\)
